task.title: Write a job post from the store manager's notes
task.brief: A retail store manager has sent you rough notes for a new opening. Turn them into a clear job post for a job portal and WhatsApp. Take about 20 minutes. A good post has a clear title, a short line about the company, location and timings, 4 to 6 main duties, must-have and nice-to-have skills kept separate, the salary range and benefits, and simple steps to apply. Use plain, friendly words. Keep it fair: leave out anything in the notes that is not linked to the job, and don't copy the manager's shorthand.
task.material:
MANAGER'S NOTES (WhatsApp)
Need 3 sales associates for our Ameerpet store, Hyderabad. Clothing and footwear. Store open 10 am to 10 pm, 2 shifts of 9 hrs, 1 weekly off (not Sat/Sun). Salary 14-17k per month + incentive on sales. PF and ESIC yes. Must talk to customers in Telugu or Hindi, some English ok. 12th pass min. 0-2 yrs exp, retail exp a plus. Billing on computer, we will train. Should be young and good looking, no one from far areas. Join within 15 days. Walk-in Mon-Fri 11 am to 4 pm, bring resume and Aadhaar. Contact: HR desk, 040-4000 1234.
key_points: Clear title: Sales Associate, Ameerpet, Hyderabad
Duties such as helping customers, billing, stock display
Must-haves: 12th pass, Telugu or Hindi; nice-to-have: retail experience
Salary Rs 14,000 to 17,000 a month plus sales incentive, PF and ESIC
Drops 'young and good looking' and 'no one from far areas' as unfair or not job-linked
How to apply: walk-in days and time, documents to bring, contact number

rubric.label: Completeness
rubric.guide: 0 = key facts missing; 3 = most facts, pay or apply steps unclear; 5 = all job, pay, timing and apply details

rubric.label: Fair and job-linked
rubric.guide: 0 = copies biased lines; 3 = softens them but keeps some; 5 = only job-linked needs, nothing unfair

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = hard to read or full of shorthand; 3 = readable but messy; 5 = clean headings, short lines, easy to scan

rubric.label: Appeal to candidates
rubric.guide: 0 = cold or confusing; 3 = plain but fine; 5 = friendly, shows why the job is worth applying for
